svg.title: Engineering reference - source page 98
svg.desc: Guest-suite pool system: hotel check-in/billing; touchscreen filling, draining, temperature control and payment extension; supply PI valve; electromagnetic flow meter; temperature/level transmitters; underwater lights; drain valve; valve/lighting cabinet; hotel server; touchscreen; DCS, system server and network switch. Key: 系统服务器 = system server; 网络交换机 = network switch; 数据采集/处理模块 = data-acquisition/processing module; 设备控制柜 = control cabinet; 比例积分调节阀 = PI control valve; 液位变送器 = level transmitter; 温度变送器 = temperature transmitter; 压力变送器 = pressure transmitter; 电动两通阀 = motorised two-way valve; 水温显示屏 = temperature display; 臭氧发生器 = ozone generator; 计量投药泵 = dosing pump; 电磁流量计 = electromagnetic flow meter; 注水 = fill; 排水 = drain; 控温 = temperature control; 续费 = payment extension.
